latent_loading_meta.rationale: Commercial AIP demand shares software/AI factors but contract conversion remains highly idiosyncratic.

long_run_growth_y8.rationale: Long-run government growth normalizes toward durable program expansion, not Q2 hypergrowth.

latent_loading_meta.rationale: Government demand has common defense-budget exposure with contract-specific risk.

base_revenue_quarterly_meta.formula: Q2 total revenue 1.935464B - U.S. commercial 0.764B - U.S. government 0.809B = 0.362464B.

initial_growth.rationale: International growth is lower and more execution-sensitive than U.S. segments; range allows contraction.

long_run_growth_y8.rationale: International maturity remains slower than U.S. growth and can stagnate in downside cases.

growth_half_life_years_meta.rationale: International growth normalizes over a longer enterprise sales cycle.

latent_loading_meta.rationale: Lower loading reflects country/product mix and customer-specific execution.

current_margin_meta.formula: H1 2026 GAAP-definition FCF = 2.115332B operating cash flow - 0.021955B PP&E purchases = 2.093377B; / 3.568047B H1 revenue = 58.67%.

terminal_margin_Y5.rationale: Y5 GAAP-defined cash margin deliberately normalizes far below current H1 58.7%; wide range absorbs SBC/dilution, sales intensity and contract-conversion uncertainty without using adjusted FCF.

terminal_margin_Y8.rationale: Long-run cash margin compresses further at center as hypergrowth matures; broad tail preserves operating-leverage uncertainty.

half_life_years_meta.rationale: Mean reversion spans several reporting periods rather than one quarter.

shock_sigma_meta.rationale: Quarterly company-specific cash-margin uncertainty; separate from Joint Layer shared drivers.

shock_persistence_meta.rationale: Adjacent-quarter operating/cash-conversion shocks are persistent but mean-reverting.

lower_bound_meta.rationale: Plausible severe cash-margin floor for the modeled archetype; not a failure-event probability.

upper_bound_meta.rationale: Prevents temporary cash-conversion peaks from becoming permanent terminal economics.

multiple.rationale: Hypergrowth software can retain a premium near term, but multiple uncertainty is intentionally very wide.
Premium software FCF multiple with explicit compression tail as growth normalizes and SBC/dilution economics matter.
Maturity compression while preserving platform/software duration upside.
Primary parity reference bridge. Mode 11x / 30x Y5 FCF multiple implies ~36.7% parity margin, aligned with the 36% Y5 cash-margin center; wide tails reflect revenue-multiple uncertainty.

factor_correlations_meta.rationale: Positive co-movement between operating growth, cash economics and duration; idiosyncratic uncertainty remains material.

default_loading_meta.rationale: Company-specific common-factor loading chosen by business maturity and concentration; not fitted to price.

annualized_sigma_meta.rationale: Model-dependent path noise used for drawdown/path diagnostics, not terminal valuation calibration.

valuation_mean_reversion_half_life_years.rationale: Valuation dislocations mean-revert over a multi-quarter horizon.

implied_revenue_cagr_5y_meta.formula: Local deterministic preflight of Reverse Valuation v1.2.0 equation from PLTR_calibration_v1.0.yaml; host run_ref remains authoritative.

discount_rate_meta.rationale: Inherited from PLTR RV base calibration.

perturbations_meta.formula: v1.1.2 local robustness: sigma_eq=(Q84-Q16)/2; growth=base-revenue-weighted RMS segment initial_growth sigma_eq; margin=Y5 terminal margin sigma_eq; multiple=Y5 log-space sigma_eq; perturbation=0.25*sigma with absolute ceilings growth 10pp, margin 5pp, multiple 20% relative.

delta_tolerance_meta.rationale: PLTR: accepted v1.1.2 tolerance for |ΔP(2x,5Y)| and |ΔP(loss>30%,5Y)|.

persistence_meta.rationale: Company execution and demand/cash-conversion conditions persist across adjacent quarters.

scenario_persistence_override.innovation_formula: eta_d,t = standardize(sum(lambda_d,r * u_r,t) + w_d * epsilon_d,t), with u_r,t root innovations after the current phase root-correlation state and epsilon_d,t the same driver idiosyncratic innovation used by BASE
scenario_persistence_override.initialization: when override begins, y_d,t-1 equals the last emitted standardized driver shock; do not initialize to zero
scenario_persistence_override.ramp_rule: numeric-to-numeric rho is linearly interpolated by phase weight; null is bypass and is not interpreted as rho=0
scenario_persistence_override.validation_rule: on a constant-rho plateau after warm-up, Var(y) must remain approximately 1 and empirical lag-1 correlation must approximate rho; insufficient plateau length is diagnostic, not failure

driver_generation.explicit_idiosyncratic_rule: These taxonomy drivers intentionally have no root mapping in v1.1. They retain independent standardized driver innovations; scenario mean/volatility overrides may still apply if a scenario explicitly names them. No root covariance is implied until a future normative reissue adds a mapping.
